import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { diaryEntries } from "../../../backend/schema/diary_entries";

// A board over "bodyFormat" fits this table, but a board needs a text column to keep each card's order in. Add one, then declare kanban: { columnField: "bodyFormat", orderField: "<that column>" }.
export const diaryEntriesCms = customizeTable<typeof diaryEntries>("diary_entries", {
    display: {
        title: "title"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "title", "bodyFormat", "visible", "latitude", "longitude"],
    fields: {
        title: {
            multiline: true
        },
        body: {
            multiline: true,
            markdown: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "title",
        "bodyFormat",
        "visible",
        "latitude",
        "longitude",
        "user",
        "languageCodeRelation",
        "body",
        "createdAt",
        "updatedAt"
    ]
});
